messages:
Sam: Quick question - I went to see a specialist out of state and their billing sent me an explanation that my Redwood plan didn't cover because they couldn't validate my member ID. I used the digital ID card but the provider said their system only accepts the 9-digit legacy ID. Do I need a new card or is there a workaround to get this claim reprocessed?

Elena (People Ops): Sorry that's annoying, Sam. First, don't pay the full bill yet if you can. Two options: 1) We can issue a printable temporary ID with the legacy 9-digit number that most billing systems accept. Email benefits@redwood.com with subject "Legacy ID request - [Your Name]" and we'll generate it same day. 2) If the provider already filed, send us the provider invoice + the provider's billing contact and we can submit a member ID crosswalk to the carrier so they can re-adjudicate the claim.

Sam: If they already denied it for lack of valid ID, is there a form the provider must fill? I can get the billing office to resubmit but want to avoid back-and-forth.

Marco: Tagging in from insurance side - if it's a denial code for "subscriber not found" we typically need the provider to include both the NPI and the submitted subscriber ID on the corrected claim. A corrected claim with the legacy ID or with the new ID plus a crosswalk note will usually get it reopened.

Elena (People Ops): Yep — ask the provider to submit a corrected claim (not new claim) and include: original claim number, date of service, your Redwood member ID, provider NPI, and note "Resubmission - subscriber ID correction". Attach the corrected claim and any denial EOBs when you upload.

Sam: Cool. How fast can you get the printable legacy ID? I left the appointment and they said they'd re-run billing today.

Elena (People Ops): If you email now with name + DOB + last 4 SSN (secure upload) we'll generate and email a PDF within business hours (usually 2-4 hours). If it's overnight/urgent, mark subject with "EXPEDITE" and include the provider due date.

BenefitsBot: Printable ID & upload: https://benefits.redwood.com/ids/printable. For secure docs use our portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/secure-upload (choose "ID request" or "Claim resubmission").

Sam: Thanks — filing the request and asking the billing office to resubmit as corrected claim. Will update here once done. :thumbsup:
